- **4 Goals & Success Metrics** — correctness (regression test must fail pre-fix), regression safety (banked suite stays green), PR+CI green, consumer-shape verified.
- **16 Acceptance Criteria checkboxes** — covering DISS-001 test existence, fix applied, test passes, type-check, lint, dry-run, single-chunk, §4.5 gate, PR open, consumer query in PR body, CI green, bb-review triggered, no new providers, review gate, audit gate.
- **Out of scope** — backfill, DB-level per-chunk cursors, Dune, new providers, bb-review as evidence.
